title.zh: 造出并运行一个最前沿的大语言模型，需要什么
title.en: What It Takes to Build and Run a Frontier Language Model

desc.zh: 从一个当场能拆开的小 Transformer 出发：参数和算力怎么数、规模定律怎么分配算力、训练和推理的账单怎么算、KV 缓存、量化、专家混合，以及 2026 年前沿的真实数字。
desc.en: Starting from a tiny transformer you can take apart in the page: how to count parameters and compute, how scaling laws split a budget, the training and inference bills, the KV cache, quantisation, mixture of experts, and the frontier's real numbers in 2026.

desc.zh: 每层先让每个位置用注意力去前文取信息，再各自过一个 MLP，结果都加回残差流；页面上一个 27,930 个参数的真模型可以逐位拆开。
desc.en: Each layer lets every position fetch from earlier positions with attention, then think on its own with an MLP, both added back to the residual stream; a real 27,930-parameter model in the page can be stepped through.

zh: 大模型的一层在算什么

desc.zh: 两个注意力头合作的电路：一个记下“我前面是谁”，另一个找到当前字母上次出现之后的位置并照抄；小模型里真的长出了一个。
desc.en: A two-head circuit: one writes down which token came before, the other finds where the current token appeared before and copies what followed; the page's tiny model grew one.

desc.zh: 信号每过一层被乘一次，几十层后不是爆炸就是消失；残差让每层只往流上加一点，pre-LN 让每层看到的输入大小不变，深网络才训得动。
desc.en: A signal multiplied at every layer explodes or vanishes after dozens of layers; residuals make each layer add a little, pre-LN keeps each layer's input at a standard size, and deep networks become trainable.

zh: 深度网络为什么难训练
en: why are deep networks hard to train

title.zh: 参数量与每个 token 的运算量
title.en: Parameter count and FLOPs per token

desc.zh: 参数约 12 × 层数 × 宽度²，读一个 token 约 2N 次运算，训练约 6N；按公开配置数出来和 GPT-3、Llama 3 的公布值一字不差。
desc.en: Parameters are about 12 × layers × width², reading a token costs about 2N operations and training about 6N; counted from published configurations, the totals match GPT-3 and Llama 3 exactly.

en: what is a parameter in AI

title.zh: 训练曲线与能力突然出现
title.en: The training curve and sudden abilities

desc.zh: 小模型真实的 3000 步训练记录：AdamW、预热和余弦退火；第 250 到 350 步之间归纳头成形，第二遍的猜对率从 45% 跳到 96%。
desc.en: The tiny model's real 3,000-step training record with AdamW, warm-up and cosine decay; between steps 250 and 350 the induction head forms and second-pass accuracy jumps from 45% to 96%.

title.zh: 规模定律与 Chinchilla 最优

desc.zh: 损失随参数和数据按幂律下降；给定算力 C ≈ 6ND，有一个最优的“模型多大、读多少”；Hoffmann 原文拟合与 Epoch 重拟合的争议。
desc.en: Loss falls as a power law in parameters and data; for a compute budget C ≈ 6ND there is a best split of model size and tokens; the dispute between Hoffmann's fit and Epoch's re-fit.

title.zh: 训练一个大模型要多少钱
title.en: What training a large model costs

desc.zh: 6 × 参数 × token 得总运算，除以芯片峰值和利用率得卡时，再乘功率和单价；Llama 3.1 405B 约 2,600 万 H100 卡时、66 天、6500 万美元。
desc.en: 6 × parameters × tokens gives total compute; divided by peak speed and utilisation it gives GPU-hours, then power and price; Llama 3.1 405B comes to about 26M H100-hours, 66 days and $65M.

en: how much does it cost to train GPT

desc.zh: 预训练后的指令微调、人类反馈强化学习及其后继；LoRA 冻住原矩阵只训练一个低秩小矩阵，GPT-3 上训练参数少约一万倍。
desc.en: Instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback and its successors after pretraining; LoRA freezes each matrix and trains a small low-rank one, about ten thousand times fewer parameters on GPT-3.

title.zh: 基准测试的误差、饱和与污染

desc.zh: 一份有限的考卷自带抽样误差：500 道题时一个分数约 ±3.5 个百分点；错题让分数饱和，背过的题让分数虚高。
desc.en: A finite test carries sampling error: about ±3.5 points on 500 questions; wrong answer keys saturate scores and memorised questions inflate them.

desc.zh: 生成时把每个位置的键和值算一次就存起来，总运算从随长度平方增长变成线性；代价是缓存随上下文变大，Llama 3 70B 每个 token 327,680 字节。
desc.en: During generation each position's keys and values are computed once and kept, turning quadratic work into linear; the price is a cache that grows with context, 327,680 bytes per token for Llama 3 70B.

title.zh: 推理的屋顶线：为什么受内存带宽限制
title.en: The inference roofline: why decoding is memory-bound

desc.zh: 单人解码时每写一个 token 都要把全部权重读一遍，速度由带宽决定；批量把读权重的成本分摊，从第一性原理算出每百万 token 的成本。
desc.en: Decoding for one user reads every weight per token, so bandwidth sets the speed; batching shares that read, and the cost per million tokens follows from first principles.

title.zh: 量化：把权重压成更少的位

desc.zh: 把页面上的小模型量化到 8、4、3、2 位当场重测：8 位和 4 位几乎无损，2 位时归纳头被压坏；4 位权重让单人解码快近 4 倍。
desc.en: The page's tiny model quantised to 8, 4, 3 and 2 bits and re-measured: 8 and 4 bits barely change it, 2 bits breaks the induction head; 4-bit weights make single-user decoding nearly 4× faster.

desc.zh: 把 MLP 换成很多并排的专家，每个 token 只去分数最高的几个；总参数大、激活参数小，难处是路由偏心和超出容量被丢掉。
desc.en: The MLP becomes many parallel experts and each token visits only the top few; total parameters are large and active ones small, and the hard part is a lopsided router dropping tokens over capacity.

title.zh: 投机解码、蒸馏与推理 token
title.en: Speculative decoding, distillation and reasoning tokens

desc.zh: 小模型先写几个草稿 token，大模型一次前向全部检查，输出分布不变；默认条件下快 2.8 倍。还有蒸馏、检索增强和推理 token 的成本。
desc.en: A small draft model writes a few tokens and the large model checks them in one pass with the output distribution unchanged, 2.8× faster by default; plus distillation, retrieval and what reasoning tokens cost.

title.zh: 可解释性：消融、叠加与稀疏自编码器
title.en: Interpretability: ablation, superposition and sparse autoencoders

desc.zh: 把小模型的注意力头逐个拆掉：拆掉归纳头，第二遍猜对率从 100% 掉到 0.6%。大模型的叠加现象与稀疏自编码器仍是有争议的研究前沿。
desc.en: Remove the tiny model's heads one at a time: without the induction head second-pass accuracy falls from 100% to 0.6%. Superposition and sparse autoencoders in large models remain a contested research frontier.

title.zh: 2026 年的前沿：算力、价格、考卷与法规
title.en: The frontier in 2026: compute, prices, tests and law

desc.zh: 带日期和来源的前沿数字：最大训练的估计算力和增速、上下文长度、HLE 排名、每百万 token 价格、吉瓦级数据中心、欧盟与加州的算力门槛，以及几个公开的未决问题。
desc.en: Dated, sourced frontier numbers: estimated largest training runs and their growth, context lengths, HLE standings, prices per million tokens, gigawatt data centres, EU and California compute thresholds, and open questions.

en: will AI run out of data

title.zh: 读大模型新闻时问的五个问题
title.en: Five questions for the next AI headline

desc.zh: 总参数还是激活参数、算力是公布还是估计、分数的误差、价格对应什么上下文、能力跳变是怎么测的。
desc.en: Total or active parameters, disclosed or estimated compute, the error on a score, which context a price is for, and how a sudden ability was measured.

en: how to read a model card
how to judge a model launch
